name: mini-roads-native
description: Capacitor wrapper for Mini Roads (web assets live in ../pwa)

scripts.android: cap sync android && cap open android
scripts.ios: cap sync ios && cap open ios
scripts.build:android: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
scripts.build:android:release: cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat bundleRelease
